LOGIC ADVENTURE 28 · CLASS 30

Penguin’s Ice Block Builder

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Completing towers

Each tower misses its top block — tap the block that completes every ice tower.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · COMPLETING TOWERS

Penguin’s Ice Block Builder

Each tower needs one more block! Tap the block that completes it.

The blue tower: big blue, medium blue… which block goes on top?

The red-yellow tower: red, yellow, red… which block goes on top?

The shape tower: rectangle, circle, square… which block goes on top?

All towers built!

A little blue block, a yellow block, and a pink circle block.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains completing towers on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Illustration note: The printed sheet shows one shared block pile for three towers with three different completion rules (blues shrink, red-yellow alternates, shapes alternate). The game presents each tower with its own three blocks and spells the rule in the prompt.

Prefer paper? The Penguin’s Ice Block Builder worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
